name: ACME Corporation Reference Data
description: Source data for ACME Corporation: a synthetic four-entity investment-bank holding group (Group, UK, US, HK) with LEIs, business units, portfolios, books, and staff accounts, used as the system's fully-populated reference/demo entity.
naming_blurb: "Acme" is the archetypal fictional-company name, from the Acme Corporation of Looney Tunes' Road Runner cartoons -- now a generic byword for a placeholder business. It is used here, as in countless other software test fixtures, to signal plainly that this is synthetic reference/demo data, not a real institution.

methodologies.name: OreStudio Code Generation Methodology
methodologies.description: Methodology for generating artefact files using the OreStudio code generator

methodologies.name: ACME Counterparty Netting Methodology
methodologies.description: Counterparty netting data for the ACME legal entities: master agreements, netting sets and credit support annexes, built from the shape of the ORE samples and made realistic

catalogs.name: ACME Corporation
catalogs.description: Synthetic investment-bank holding group used to exercise the full system (organisation, RBAC, trading structure).

datasets.name: ACME Corporation LEI Entities
datasets.description: ACME Corporation's four legal entities (Group, UK, US, HK), each with a checksum-valid synthetic LEI on GLEIF's reserved 9695 test prefix.

datasets.name: ACME Corporation LEI Relationships
datasets.description: Parent/subsidiary consolidation relationships linking each ACME Corporation office to the holding company.

datasets.name: ACME Corporation Business Units
datasets.description: Trading desks (IR Swaps, Credit Trading, FX Rates) and support functions (Middle Office, Market Risk) per ACME Corporation office.

datasets.name: ACME Corporation Portfolios
datasets.description: One physical portfolio per desk, rolled up under a per-office virtual Global Markets portfolio.

datasets.name: ACME Corporation Books
datasets.description: One trading book per desk portfolio.

datasets.name: ACME Corporation Staff Accounts
datasets.description: Locale-appropriate staff accounts (desk heads, traders, managers, analysts) per ACME Corporation business unit, one fixed shared password. NOTE: requires a new 'accounts' artefact_type/DQ artefact table/publish-from-dq function -- see the server-side-orchestration follow-up task; this dataset is defined ahead of that infrastructure landing.
datasets.business_context: Staff accounts for ACME Corporation, one per desk/support-function role

datasets.name: ACME Corporation LEI Counterparties
datasets.description: Publish trigger that makes the four ACME legal entities counterparties of one another, with their group hierarchy and LEI identifiers. It carries no rows of its own.

datasets.name: ACME Corporation Netting Agreements
datasets.description: ISDA master agreements between each ACME legal entity and its banks and group entities. One dataset for each entity.

datasets.name: ACME Corporation Netting Sets
datasets.description: Netting sets of each ACME legal entity, one for each collateral regime under an agreement. One dataset for each entity.

datasets.name: ACME Corporation CSAs
datasets.description: Credit support annexes of each ACME legal entity: currency, overnight index, thresholds, minimum transfer amounts and margin periods. One dataset for each entity.
